versions.changelog:
Initial release of WhatSync skill

- Allows users to read, search, summarize, and reply to their own synced WhatsApp chats, groups, contacts, and files.
- Provides step-by-step instructions for checking account status, reading/searching messages, and sending messages.
- Ensures privacy by accessing only user-approved chats and groups.
- Includes clear safety guidance for sending messages and using business numbers.
- Outlines how to handle attachments and contact information.
